themes.name: Municipal Service Access
themes.rule: Proposals that make city services, procedures, or public internet access easier to reach through in-person, phone, or online channels.

themes.name: Affordable Housing Supply
themes.rule: Proposals that create, require, convert, subsidize, or make pricing more transparent for affordable residential housing.

themes.name: Building Clean Energy
themes.rule: Proposals that install renewable energy or improve energy efficiency in municipal or residential buildings.

themes.name: Waste Reduction Systems
themes.rule: Proposals that reduce disposable waste or expand collection and diversion of recyclable or compostable materials.

themes.name: Parks and Green Amenities
themes.rule: Proposals that add or improve neighborhood green spaces, trees, playgrounds, dog areas, or community gardens.

themes.name: School Learning Support
themes.rule: Proposals that improve pupils' learning conditions, school facilities, teaching capacity, meals, tutoring, or educational instruction.

themes.name: Health and Home Care
themes.rule: Proposals that expand access to medical, mental-health, preventive, specialist, primary-care, or in-home care services.

themes.name: Culture and Library Access
themes.rule: Proposals that broaden public access to cultural events, museums, libraries, public art, or other cultural spaces.

themes.name: Community Safety Response
themes.rule: Proposals that improve safety through policing, surveillance, emergency-response facilities, or lighting in unsafe areas.

themes.name: Public Transit Service
themes.rule: Proposals that make bus or public-transit travel more frequent, available, trackable, or affordable for riders.

themes.name: Safe Walking and Cycling
themes.rule: Proposals that physically redesign streets to protect pedestrians or cyclists from motor traffic.

themes.name: Jobs and Small Business
themes.rule: Proposals that support workers, local hiring, freelancers, or small businesses through training, procurement, workspace, licensing, or finance.
